observation: Read all2863characters. The abstract opens with an economic-only management failure and its ecological consequence,then proposes a social/economic/ecological re-optimization. It uses Faustmann as a limited baseline,defines CIF from carbon,economic and biodiversity indices,adds AHP country weights and AVF for comprehensive quality,and hands the index to two contrasting case studies. The developed-country case produces the counterintuitive no-harvest result;the developing-country case retains harvesting as necessary for the objective. Sensitivity,model limits and a public newspaper explanation close the chain. Preserve the direct contrast and the explicit no-harvest/harvest split;reported case outcomes are model outputs,not verified forestry advice. Ligature and encoding defects (economical/effects and carbon-sequestration forms) remain source-recovery work;no formula or figure interpretation.
